report.title: Secret & Key Inventory — Local Static Evidence

handling.actualEgressStatement: Approved local public-repository metadata, selected source/document content and derived findings were processed in the active OpenAI Codex session. Assessment collection used no network provider, registry, scanner or remote GitHub/CI query. The user separately authorized commits and pushes of reviewed assessment artifacts to the existing origin remote.
redactions: No raw source excerpts, credential values, private overlays or author identities are included.
Evidence uses portable repository-relative paths; aggregate counts and team roles replace personal activity.

permissionsGaps.impact: The report is partial; missing evidence is not a pass and no numeric maturity score or delivery authorization is inferred.
permissionsGaps.summary: The limited current-checkout indicator search is not a comprehensive secret scanner or Git-history review. Remote secret stores, rotation/audit state, provider token scopes and expiry were not queried; credential values and ignored environment contents were excluded.
Service region, retention/deletion and approval expiry are not supplied by local repository evidence.
permissionsGaps.impact: Owner governance details remain unknown; assessment findings await user review.

findings.title: Numeric test fixtures trigger password-name heuristics without credentials
findings.description: Bandit reported three B105 observations on numeric values in test fixtures. One value is an exam passing-score count, and two are aggregate pass-status counts. They are neither strings nor credentials and cannot grant access, so the observations are heuristic false positives.

remediation.summary: No security remediation is indicated; retain the triage and use narrowly scoped scanner annotations only if recurring noise obscures actionable findings.
steps: Keep the raw scanner observations as reproducible evidence.
If Bandit becomes a recurring gate, document any scoped B105 test-fixture suppression.
Continue scanning non-test credential-like assignments without this exception.
